newsitem.title: USA: MGI sees Nov 30 qtr gain from sale of plant.
newsitem.headline: MGI sees Nov 30 qtr gain from sale of plant.

text.p: MGI Properties said on Wednesday it would book a gain of about $1.45 million or $0.13 per share in the quarter ending November 30, for the sale of a distribution and manufacturing facility in Massachusetts.
MGI said it sold a 77,400 square-foot distribution and manufacturing building in Westwood, Massachusetts, million or about $39 per square foot.
It bought the building in November 1993 for $1.52 million or $19.57 per square foot, the company said.

Chairman W. Pearce Coues said this was the first sale of a Massachusetts property since MGI began reinvesting in New England and was effected after the tenant in the building renewed their lease at a significantly higher rent level.
In addition to the periodic sale of buildings in non-core markets, Coues said MGI might selectively sell properties located in Massachusetts, which have reached a mature value.
